none: PAS LON-156B17: Roman samianware cup fragment
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of a Roman samianware cup, type DR27. The fragment contains parts of the rim and base of the bowl; the rim is lipped and the base is worn. The body of the bowl is two-tiered, each tier is curved. On the internal surface in the centre of the bowl is part of a maker's stamp with the letters 'PA...' visible.
